system.description:
Contest: your Strength check vs. the target's Strength or Dexterity check (its choice), against a creature you have Restrained. You win, it is knocked Prone.

Combat Manoeuvres, Manoeuvre: replaces one attack.

  • To knock a Restrained target down, spend a further attack to Overbear it (a second contest).

Contest: both sides roll d20 + the stated attribute modifier; the higher total wins and ties go to the defender.

Target one creature and press Use: both sides roll, and the result is applied.
